taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_typical_m.note: FEIS's fairy slipper review (Reeves 2005, read 2026-10-15): "The erect stem stands between 2 to 8 inches (5-20 cm) tall, extending from a bulb-like corm".

traits.leaf_length_m.note: FEIS's fairy slipper review (Reeves 2005, read 2026-10-15): "It has a single, basal green leaf that is 1 to 2 inches (3-6 cm) long".

traits.shoot_leaves.note: FEIS's fairy slipper review (Reeves 2005, read 2026-10-15): a single basal leaf.

traits.inflorescence.note: FEIS's fairy slipper review (Reeves 2005, read 2026-10-15): "The flower is usually solitary (rarely with 2 flowers)".

traits.perennation.note: FEIS's fairy slipper review (Reeves 2005, read 2026-10-15): "a bulb-like corm".

traits.flower_size_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it.

traits.flowering_months.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as the FEIS review read gives no months for the Northwest.

generator.params.note: White bog orchid's values, changed by hand for fairy slipper: one short stem from the corm with its single leaf at the foot (FEIS, Reeves 2005) and one nodding flower at the top. Flower size and nod by eye; not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: 13 cm at 4 years, the middle of FEIS's 5-20 cm stem (Reeves 2005). Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: By eye, after FEIS's description (Reeves 2005): a long, scoop-shaped pale lip (the accent), three erect-spreading pink sepals and two narrow, pointed petals (the narrow, pointed petal card); a purplish stem; one broad, dark green leaf.

traits.fruiting_months.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as the FEIS review read gives no months.

traits.height_max_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L32237), as no source read gives it.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L32237), as no source read gives it.

traits.leaf_shape.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L32237), as no source read gives it.
